segments.tts: Hockey's wildest moments, round three. Let's go!
Bobby Orr, 1970. Overtime. Scores the Cup winner – then FLIES!
Forty seconds into overtime – Boston's first Cup since 1941.
He flew. I can't even jump.
Wayne Gretzky, 1981. Fifty goals in thirty-nine games!
Five that night – the last one into an empty net.
Back in my day, fifty took fifty.
1952: Detroit fans throw an octopus. Eight arms – eight wins for the Cup!
And who has to pick it up?
1993: Teemu Selänne breaks the rookie record – and shoots his own glove!
Seventy-six goals. Still the rookie record.
Nope. It's the only save I make all day.
